lines: The Composer autoloader is optimized beyond level 1. The manual allows only config.optimize-autoloader: an authoritative class map breaks the upgrade of the app, and APCu is no required extension.
2 uses of the private API of the server in 2 files. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.
vimeo/psalm is in require-dev of composer.json. The manual recommends a vendor-bin/ of bamarni/composer-bin-plugin per tool, so that the dependencies of a tool cannot conflict with those of the app.

places: lib/Operation.php:99 OCP\EventDispatcher\GenericEvent: deprecated since Nextcloud 22; use \OCP\EventDispatcher\Event
lines: 1 use in 1 file of the public API that is deprecated in Nextcloud 35. The text of the tag names the replacement where it has one.
